mustFix.problem: Hero image is broken (dist/media/hero-C1*.webp are 30-byte stubs) and its alt text paints over the logo
mustFix.fix: Ship a decodable hero image; until the library lands, hide a failed img (onerror -> hidden) and give .hero a designed fog-gradient fallback so alt text never renders

mustFix.problem: RH logo and nav links are dark-on-dark, far below 4.5:1
mustFix.fix: Set header text/logo to --paper (#F3EFE6) while the header sits over t-deep; switch to ink only once the header is solid paper

mustFix.problem: Blank cream rectangle with no image and no caption
mustFix.fix: Fill the slot or give it the same captioned placeholder as the other figures; never ship an empty box

mustFix.problem: Two grey skeleton bars float in the header area
mustFix.fix: Remove or correctly size whatever draws them (dial pill / menu lines) so the mobile header shows logo + menu button only

elevate.move: Make the Season Dial the scroll's clock: four real arcs, the active season filled and the rest hairline, pinned top-right and swept by ScrollTrigger across the four almanac spreads with the season label changing at each dateline

Let the countdown tool speak the dial's language: on date entry the tool's ring sweeps from today to the deadline, marks the book-by date on its rim and shows the two-visit plan as ticks on the arc, so the output is an almanac diagram, not a line of text
